text: 天眼查App显示，8月4日，上海芯联启辰二期私募投资基金合伙企业（有限合伙）成立，执行事务合伙人为芯联私募基金管理（杭州）合伙企业（有限合伙），出资额7.81亿人民币，经营范围为以私募基金从事股权投资、投资管理、资产管理等活动。合伙人信息显示，该基金由芯联股权投资（杭州）有限公司，宁波江丰电子材料股份有限公司、上海申和投资有限公司等共同出资。
text_en: Tianyancha App shows that on August 4, Shanghai Xinlian Qichen Phase II Private Equity Investment Fund Partnership (Limited Partnership) was established, with the executive partner being Xinlian Private Equity Fund Management (Hangzhou) Partnership (Limited Partnership), with a capital contribution of 781 million yuan, and the business scope covering equity investment, investment management, asset management and other activities through private funds. Partner information shows the fund is jointly funded by Xinlian Equity Investment (Hangzhou) Co., Ltd., Ningbo Konfoong Materials International Co., Ltd., Shanghai Shenhe Investment Co., Ltd. and others.
